description: Implementation of the QuicEndpointBase class and related classes for QUIC protocol simulation, including packet handling, address generation, and trace recording.

classes.name: QuicEndpointBase
classes.description: Base class representing a QUIC endpoint in the simulation, handling packet transmission, reception, and trace recording.

classes.name: QuicEndpointBase::Writer
classes.description: Nested class responsible for writing packets from the endpoint.

methods.name: HashNameIntoFive32BitIntegers
methods.description: Generates five 32-bit integers from a SHA-1 hash of a name.

methods.name: GetAddressFromName
